subject: general
question: Bihar begins vegetable exports to ___________ via VEGFED cooperative.
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Dubai**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Bihar begins vegetable exports to Dubai via VEGFED cooperative.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
Bihar begins **vegetable exports** through **VEGFED**, modeled on dairy cooperative **COMFED**.

 
 
• 
 
**First consignment** of **1500 kg** sent to **Dubai** via **Varanasi**.

 
 
• 
 
**Cooperative Minister Prem Kumar** flagged it off for **LuLu Mall, Dubai**.

 
 
• 
 
**10 types of vegetables** exported, including **jackfruit, cauliflower, brinjal**, etc.

 
 
• 
 
**Farmers** expected to earn **20x more** than domestic rates.

 
 
• 
 
Next destination: **Singapore**.

 
 
• 
 
Govt plans **534 'Tarkari' outlets** (200 plots identified; funds released).

 
 
• 
 
**VEGFED committees** already formed in **495 blocks**.

 
 
• 
 
Initiative launched during the **International Year of Cooperatives**.
